verdict.rationale: Drata's own API docs show a multi-framework model: List Frameworks, Create Custom Framework, framework requirements, and control requirement mappings and comparisons. That points to several frameworks being managed in one platform, and custom frameworks are created through the product itself. However, no evidence names HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as supported out-of-the-box frameworks. missing for 10: evidence of prebuilt HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS frameworks, cross-framework control mapping documentation beyond endpoint names, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool
